We're adding a feature that stores patient appointment notes and sends reminder emails; our users include people in the EU. What compliance concerns apply and how should we approach them?

Available focused skills you may consult:
- compliance-security: secure coding, authn/authz, injection, secrets, sessions, secure defaults (OWASP/NIST)
- compliance-vulnerability-management: CVEs, dependency advisories, CodeQL/SAST triage, patch/remediation, evidence
- compliance-accessibility: WCAG 2.2 keyboard/semantics/names/focus/contrast/forms
- compliance-privacy: PII collection, minimization, retention, deletion, logging, vendor sharing
- compliance-gdpr: EU/UK personal data, lawful basis, data-subject rights, DPIA, breach
- compliance-hipaa: health data / ePHI, safeguards, access/audit/transmission controls
- compliance-auditability: traceability, audit logs, approval/remediation evidence
- threat-model: assets, actors, trust boundaries, abuse cases, controls for new attack surface
